newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Pre-vote NZ survey gives opposition 68 seats.
newsitem.headline: Pre-vote NZ survey gives opposition 68 seats.

text.p: A survey of 1,000 New Zealand voters taken over the past week by Victoria University and published by TV1 after polls closed in Saturday's general election would give the three main opposition parties 68 seats in the 120-member parliament.

The survey gave the conservative National Party 33 percent (42 seats), centre-left Labour 26 percent (34 seats), the left-wing Alliance 15 percent (19 seats), nationalist New Zealand First 12 percent (15 seats), the radical free market Act seven percent (nine seats), the Christian Coalition 4.5 percent (no seats) and centrist United 0.8 percent with one electorate
